binding.styling: plain CSS with repository design tokens
binding.component_system: bespoke by default; evaluated accessible library allowed

browser_support.policy: Fixture exercises current Playwright Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit; consumers declare their own supported versions.
browser_support.fallback: Render an honest unavailable or indeterminate state with a keyboard-visible alternative.

api_contract.compatibility: Reject unknown major schema versions and render an observable compatibility error.

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA for the fixture's applicable criteria
assistive_technology: representative macOS Safari and VoiceOver flow

trusted-types.rationale: Application readiness is exercised; delivery owns the header.

safe-urls-dom-clobbering.rationale: Navigation input is validated without named-property lookup.

csrf-cookie-coupling.rationale: Frontend documents the cookie assumption; backend enforces CSRF.

cors-handoff.rationale: CORS is a server policy, not client authorization.

third-party-scripts-sri.rationale: Fixture loads no third-party runtime script.

dependency-install-scripts.rationale: Lockfile and audit posture are checked.

source-maps.rationale: Frontend declares sensitivity; delivery owns publication.

client-logs-analytics.rationale: No sensitive data or credentials enter telemetry.

scenarios: cold navigation to the browser contract fixture
metrics: compressed emitted JavaScript and CSS bytes
performance.environment: local production preview with retained browser and host identity

routing.rationale: Fixture exercises an in-app route and focus move.

internationalization.rationale: Fixture proves the declaration path, not a multilingual product.

ssr-hydration.rationale: Fixture is a static client-rendered application.

gates.decision: Declared browser engines pass without skips.
